stories.title: Baidu’s Profit, Revenue Continue to Fall as It Pivots to AI
stories.simple_summary: Baidu, a Chinese search company, is making less profit and less money overall. They're trying to shift their business toward AI to fix this.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people doing business with Baidu — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Texas Tech University Is Using A.I. to Cut Left-Leaning Content
stories.simple_summary: Texas Tech University is using AI to identify and remove content that leans left-wing from their system.
stories.why_it_matters: If you send materials to Texas Tech, be aware they're filtering content this way, though this is mainly a college policy question rather than something affecting everyday people.

stories.title: Many recent grads say AI is making it harder to get a job. Economists aren’t so sure
stories.simple_summary: Some recent college graduates think AI is making it harder for them to find jobs. But economists studying the data aren't sure if that's actually true yet.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have young people looking for work, it's worth watching, but the experts aren't convinced AI is the main job problem — yet.

stories.title: Appeals court flags AI-generated fake cases in San Antonio ISD lawsuit
stories.simple_summary: A court found that fake legal cases created by AI were used in a real lawsuit in Texas. The judge caught them because they didn't make sense.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI makes mistakes that can cause real legal problems — don't trust AI to create official documents without a human checking them carefully.

stories.title: Anthropic’s annualized revenue surges to $65B
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic, a company that makes AI, says their yearly earnings jumped to $65 billion (though this projection is based on recent growth, not confirmed sales).
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it shows the AI business is very hot right now, but nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: AI automation startup Relay shuts down, staff joins Google’s Chrome team
stories.simple_summary: A small AI startup called Relay is closing down, and its team members are moving to Google to work on AI features in the Chrome web browser.
stories.why_it_matters: Google is adding more AI features to Chrome, so you may see AI tools appear in your web browser soon.

stories.title: Campton Township man Jeremy Batterman accused of using AI to create child porn: Kane County officials
stories.simple_summary: Police in Illinois say a man used AI to create illegal fake images of children.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI is being misused for serious crimes — it's a reminder of the real harms AI can cause.

stories.title: Billionaire Ray Dalio Says Today's Artificial Intelligence (AI) Market Echoes 1929 and 2000. History Says Investors Should Watch Valuations Closely.
stories.simple_summary: A very wealthy investor says the current AI boom feels like the stock market crashes of 1929 and 2000 — too much money chasing risky bets.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — he's warning that AI company stock prices might be too high, but nothing you need to act on personally.

stories.title: Amazon, which started off selling books, is destroying rare texts to train AI
stories.simple_summary: Amazon is buying and destroying rare old books so AI companies can use them to train their AI systems (called LLMs, which learn from written text).
stories.why_it_matters: Rare books and knowledge are being lost permanently to train AI — this is a real loss to history and culture.

stories.title: Groq raises $350M to fuel its pivot from AI chips to neocloud
stories.simple_summary: A company called Groq raised a large sum of money and is switching from making AI computer chips to running data centers (huge computer warehouses).
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Nvidia investing $1.5B in SoftBank data center developer behind OpenAI project
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia, a big computer chip company, is investing $1.5 billion to make sure their chips power a data center for OpenAI.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it shows Nvidia is betting heavily on being the main supplier for AI companies, but nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: The Economy Has Spoken: Stuff That’s AI-Generated Has Almost Zero Value
stories.simple_summary: Markets are showing that AI-created content (like art or writing made entirely by AI with no human) is worth almost nothing to buyers.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're selling products or services, pure AI-generated content won't impress customers — people want human skill and judgment.
